related_questions.question: What are the requirements to enter Canada from the US?

text_blocks.snippet: To enter Canada from the U.S., most US citizens need a valid passport or an equivalent travel document. If flying to a Canadian airport, an Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA) is also required unless they have a valid US passport or other approved document. Additionally, travelers must prove they have sufficient funds for their stay and convince border officials that they will return to the US.
snippet_highlighted_words: a valid passport or an equivalent travel document

list.title: Passport:
list.snippet: A valid U.S. passport is generally required, but a birth certificate and a government-issued photo ID (like a driver's license) can be used for land or sea travel.

list.title: eTA:
list.snippet: If flying to Canada, US citizens need a valid eTA, unless they are using a valid US passport or other approved document.

list.title: Proof of funds:
list.snippet: Travelers must demonstrate they have enough money to support themselves during their stay.

list.title: Ties to the US:
list.snippet: Border officials need to be convinced that the traveler will leave Canada and return to the US.

list.title: Not inadmissible:
list.snippet: Travelers must not have any criminal or immigration-related convictions that would make them inadmissible to Canada.

list.title: Enhanced Driver's License:
list.snippet: An enhanced driver's license can be used for land and sea travel, but not for air travel.

list.title: Nexus and FAST cards:
list.snippet: These cards grant trusted traveler privileges and can be used for crossing the border.

list.title: Returning to the US:
list.snippet: While a birth certificate and photo ID may be sufficient for entering Canada, they may not be enough for returning to the US.

text_blocks.snippet: For Lawful Permanent Residents of the US:

list.snippet: Passport: A valid passport from their country of citizenship is required.
Green Card: A valid green card is also required as proof of US residency.

related_questions.question: What do you need to cross the border into Canada by car?

text_blocks.snippet: To drive from the U.S. to Canada, you'll need a valid passport (or other appropriate travel document) for each person in the vehicle, a valid driver's license, vehicle registration, and proof of auto insurance. You may also need to declare any goods you're bringing into Canada that exceed your personal exemption limits.

Driver's License: A valid driver's license for the class of vehicle you are driving is required.
Vehicle Registration: You'll need to show the vehicle's registration documents.
Proof of Insurance: Proof of valid auto insurance is necessary.
